widgets_values: In a real-world scene, a tsunami suddenly strikes a street in the background, collapsing buildings on both sides. Water, mixed with debris, hurtles towards the camera. A cat in a suit, terrified, covers its head and quickly turns and runs towards the camera. The camera gradually zooms out, revealing the tsunami approaching the cat, sending it caressing and caressing as it tumbles through the air before being swept into the water.
它正在认真地阅读书本，眼睛随着文字来回移动。表情变得严肃，然后，它合上书，若有所思地慢慢点了点头，突然它变得严肃，举起木槌向前敲击了几次镜头，木槌变得很大，带有震撼的震动特效。
